title.en: Card A-2: NP5-01a source-level comparison for kinematics (33) and crb (30) = 63 sites; zero GPU

intent.zh: 按 Chief 队列：用 A-1a/A-1b 同口径（7 步法、source 级类型映射 + 表达式分类、双侧 file:line、六类词表、自检 63/总数 139/pending=0）落 docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a2/。覆盖 kinematics（rigid_kinematics 19 + rigid_com_position 14）与 crb（rigid_mass_matrix 12 + resident_crb_init 5 + resident_crb_accumulate 3 + resident_crb_matrix 7 + rounding-note 3）。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Per Chief's queue, land np5-01a-a2/ with the A-1a/A-1b methodology: 63 sites (kinematics 33 + crb 30), source-level type mapping + expression classification, bilateral file:line, six-category vocabulary, self-check 63 sites / 139 total / pending=0. Zero GPU/window; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts or criteria changes.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a2/evidence.json`：63 站点（kinematics 33 + crb 30，逐 id 与 sites.json 行一致），每站点 id/kind/label/product_anchor(file:line)/reference_anchor(file:line)/type_mapping/classification/五项必填字段。

分类只用六类词表；`recipe-difference` 带 `value_equivalent:true`+`value_equivalence_basis`；`not-decidable` 带 6 类 reasons；`n/a` 带 why；`engine-semantic` 带 `why_engine_semantic`+`bit_level_guarantee:false`；不写覆盖率/通过率/位级等价。

`README.md`：范围/方法/分类判据/逐组统计（无通过率）/参考锚点说明/非声明；`receipt.json`：sites_total=63、pending_manual=0、np5_01a_total_sites=139、分类计数、inputs、tree.head、gates、boundaries；`manifest.txt` 自核；`logs/selfcheck.txt` PASS；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a2/**` + `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；零 GPU、零窗。
